# Island Adventures
# RIB boat tour operator — Vestmannaeyjar (Westman Islands), Iceland

> Island Adventures (Eyjasund EHF) operates guided RIB (rigid inflatable boat)
> tours around the Westman Islands from the harbour at Básaskersbryggja 6, 900
> Vestmannaeyjar, Iceland. Tours run seasonally from May through October.
> 1-hour tours cost 15,000 ISK (adults) / 9,000 ISK (children). 2-hour tours
> cost 22,000 ISK (adults) / 12,000 ISK (children). Private charters and luxury
> bespoke trips are available on request. Float suits and life vests are
> provided; scheduled tours need a minimum of 4 guests; minimum age is 6.
> Tours pass volcanic cliffs, sea caves, Elephant Rock and seabird colonies.
> Weather cancellations receive a full refund. The company holds Ferðamálastofa
> (Icelandic Tourist Board) day-tour licence 2026-045.

## Key facts
- Operator: Island Adventures (legal entity: Eyjasund EHF)
- Location: Básaskersbryggja 6, 900 Vestmannaeyjar, Iceland
- Phone: +354 865 5700
- Email: booking@islandadventures.is
- Season: May–October
- Languages: English, Icelandic
